title: stoa-imap: ENABLE command only valid in Authenticated state, not Selected (RFC 5161)
description: In session/mod.rs the ENABLE command handler guards with ImapState::Authenticated only, rejecting ENABLE in Selected state with NO. RFC 5161 section 3 states ENABLE is valid in any non-authenticated state — specifically it is valid in Selected state. RFC 9051 section 6.3.2 also permits ENABLE after SELECT. A client that selects a mailbox then sends ENABLE IMAP4rev2 will receive an incorrect NO response.
